annotations.title: Compose and export a project report PDF

description: Compose a project report PDF. Pass `projectId` or `project`; with neither, the result lists projects and no meter is spent. preview=true composes without spending and returns `previewId`. confirm=true with that `previewId` exports exactly the text that was previewed; without it, confirm composes again. Export spends records.exports and is irreversible. Returns a signed download URL, never PDF bytes.

confirm.description: When true, compose (if needed), save, export PDF, and return a download URL. Required when preview is false. Spends records.exports and cannot be undone.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

preview.description: When true, compose only — no export meter spend and no download URL.

previewId.description: From a preview result. With confirm=true it exports exactly that preview, with no second compose. A newer preview for the same project replaces it.

project.description: Project name to match, when you do not have the UUID. Case-insensitive; an exact name wins over a partial one. Matching more than one lists the candidates instead of guessing.

projectId.description: Project UUID. Omit if you pass `project`.

name: produceProjectReport
